description: From the Auburn Reporter: Three bills sponsored by Rep. Drew Stokesbary, R-Auburn, have been signed into law by Gov. Jay Inslee. House Bills 1263, 1637 and 1940 passed the House and Senate with strong bipartisan support. “I am pleased the governor signed these bills into law and believe they will strengthen public safety, improve government … Continued
title: Bills sponsored by Rep. Stokesbary signed into law - Re-Elect Drew Stokesbary
